terms.definition: A community of living things plus their nonliving surroundings, interacting as a system.
terms.whereItIs: Any area, from a puddle to a forest.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the full system in which life operates.

terms.definition: The one-way passage of energy from sun to plants to animals.
terms.function: Powers all life in the ecosystem.
terms.whyItMatters: Without new energy from the sun, ecosystems would run down.

terms.definition: The reuse of materials as decomposers break down dead matter.
terms.function: Returns nutrients to the soil for reuse.
terms.whyItMatters: It keeps nutrients available again and again.

terms.definition: A living thing that breaks down dead material.
terms.function: Recycles nutrients back to the soil.
